items.title: 10.10 Avogadro's constant by the electrolytic method

blocks.title: Avogadro constant
blocks.text: The Avogadro constant, L, is the number of specified particles (atoms, molecules or ions) in 1 mole.

An electrolytic method can give a value for the Avogadro constant by calculating the charge associated with 1 mole of electrons: L = (charge on 1 mole of electrons) / (charge on 1 electron). The charge on the electron is found by experiment to be approximately 1.60 x 10^-19 C.
